_what: The authoritative list of Daily Practice's files in this folder. 'update my harness' refreshes exactly these paths from the template's main branch and touches nothing else. Contract: docs/updating.md.
_regenerate: git ls-files, minus specs/, .specify/, tests/, .claude/skills/speckit*, docs/img/, .claude/agents/README.md, agent/knowledge-base/0*.md — then bump template_version here and in status/status.schema-template.json together. CLAUDE.md IS on the list: it is what the assistant auto-loads, so it is the file that decides whether a session reads AGENTS.md and checks the radio at all. It was excluded once, which meant an installed harness could never be taught to listen.

never_touch.status/status.json: the client's own record — pairing, stages, packages, choices
never_touch.agent/knowledge-base/01..07*.md: the client's business, captured in their words
never_touch..claude/agents/ (everything but nothing: the client's hired team; the roster README carries their rows
never_touch.anything not in the refresh list: the allowlist is the whole permission — no exceptions
